title: Welcome to SwiftClass.
body:
Welcome to SwiftClass. This slideshow will show you how to use the app.
Click Next to move on.

title: The Radial Menu
body:
The Radial Menu is the fastest way to navigate through the app.
It can be opened by pressing Space or Right Mouse at any time. 
It will appear at the mouse's position, and you can click on any of the buttons to navigate to a different page. It should look like the one below.

title: The Home Page
body:
Let's start with the basics. The home page is the starting point of SwiftClass.
It's where you can view the latest news. 
Most of your time will not be spent here, but you can still use the 5 menu buttons underneath the news to navigate to other pages. It should look like the image below.

title: The Settings Page
body:
The Settings menu is where you can change how the app works. 
This includes color changes, and notification control. The Data Management section allows you to import and export saved data, like your classes or links.

title: The Class Page
body:
The Classes Page is where you can view basic info about your classes.
You can see your teachers' names, a link associated with the class, and its assigned period.

title: The Links Page
body:
The Links Page is where you can find all the important links related to your work. 
They are fully customizable, so you can add any link you want. Additionally, they're separated into sections for each of your classes, and there's also custom-made personal sections for your specific needs. 
The top right of the menu has 8 quick access links that are for general use.

title: The Agendas Page
body:
The Agendas Page is where you can view all your upcoming events. 
They will be set up by you, and organized based on class and date. After they're set, they'll be saved to your device.

title: Getting Started
body:
To get started, you should check out Settings and personalize the app to your liking. 
Afterward, you should add classes in the, well... Classes tab. 
Feel free to re-watch this slideshow by clicking the "About this Page" button in the bottom left corner of the screen. Stay tuned for 1.0.0 on 12/1!
